units.source_text: 老师沉默不言，付过钱后就将她打发走了。

en.t: The teacher said nothing, and after paying her, sent her away.

units.source_text: 老师明知当天向导游正是我，不是别人，

en.t: The teacher knew perfectly well that I, and no one else, had been the guide that day,

units.source_text: 可他却由于无人目击我的不道德行为，就决定不让我知道这件事。

en.t: but since no one had witnessed my immoral act, he decided not to let me know about it.

units.source_text: 老师采取不予置理的态度。

en.t: The teacher chose to ignore the matter.
